import.title: Import maps
import.description: Pick Universal VTT files (.dd2vtt or .uvtt) or the JSON of a Foundry-style export together with their pictures or videos, or just pictures or videos.
import.filesHint: Select the data file and the image or video together (hold Ctrl or Shift). Files named Map_0, Map_1 become the floors of one map.

guide.title: How to export from Dungeon Alchemist
guide.universal: Best choice: Format "UniversalVTT Export". Select the .dd2vtt file together with the image or video it exported. It brings the grid, walls, doors and lights.
guide.foundry: Or "Foundry Export": select the .json together with the image or video that has the same name.
guide.video: For an animated map, pick the video file type (MP4 or WebM) and keep the .dd2vtt next to it. MP4 plays in the most browsers.
guide.image: "Image Only" works too, but carries no walls or lights. Keep the grid size in the file name (for example map_28x38.png) and the cell size is read for you.
guide.floors: Several floors: export each floor on its own and name the files Map_0, Map_1 and so on. Select them all at once and they stay together as floors.
guide.grid: Turn the grid off in the export. OpenVTT draws its own grid, so the one in the picture would double up.
guide.lights: If the map should look the same as in Dungeon Alchemist, choose "Render lights in image AND export to VTT". Walls and lights are visible to you only, never to players.

import.summary: Map {{size}} px, {{lights}} lights, {{walls}} walls and doors found.

warning.no_walls: The file has no walls or doors. In Dungeon Alchemist, export with walls and lighting turned on.
warning.truncated: The file had more walls, doors or lights than OpenVTT keeps; the extra ones were dropped.
warning.size_mismatch: The picture size does not match the grid in the file. Check the cell size below.
warning.grid_offset: The file shifts the grid from the map corner, which OpenVTT does not support yet. Check that the grid lines up.
warning.grid_guessed: No grid was found in the file name. Set the cell size by hand (for example 28x38 in the name sets it automatically).

error.too_large: That file is too large to import.
error.no_media: This file has no picture inside. Select the image or video exported with it as well.
error.unsupported_file: Use a .dd2vtt or .uvtt file, or a PNG, JPG, WebP, WebM or MP4 map.
